system.description:
Your commands are implanted so deeply that other vampires find them nearly impossible to override. The name is misleading, instilling no true loyalty, only shackles that outlast rival wills.

If another vampire attempts to use Dominate on your subject in a way that would make them act against a command you previously implanted, that vampire must spend an extra Willpower Trait and bid two extra Traits while making the test.
system.duration: As long as the original command stands
